verses.original: Ἐπειδὴ ἐπλήρωσεν πάντα αὐτοῦ τὰ ῥήματα εἰς τὰς ἀκοὰς τοῦ λαοῦ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς Καφαρναούμ
verses.transliteration: Epeidē eplērōsen panta autou ta rhēmata eis tas akoas tou laou eisēlthen eis Kapharnaoum
verses.literal: When [Jesus] had concluded . . . His - discourse in the hearing of the people He went to Capernaum

verses.original: δέ τινος ὃς ἦν αὐτῷ ἔντιμος δοῦλος Ἑκατοντάρχου ἔχων κακῶς ἤμελλεν τελευτᾶν
verses.transliteration: de tinos hos ēn autō entimos doulos Hekatontarchou echōn kakōs ēmellen teleutan
verses.literal: [There] a vvv vvv vvv highly valued servant of a centurion was sick [and] about to die

verses.original: δὲ ἀκούσας περὶ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἀπέστειλεν τῶν Ἰουδαίων πρεσβυτέρους πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐρωτῶν αὐτὸν ὅπως ἐλθὼν διασώσῃ αὐτοῦ τὸν δοῦλον
verses.transliteration: de akousas peri tou Iēsou apesteilen tōn Ioudaiōn presbyterous pros auton erōtōn auton hopōs elthōn diasōsē autou ton doulon
verses.literal: When [the centurion] heard about - Jesus he sent [some] Jewish elders - - to ask Him - to come [and] heal his - servant

verses.original: δὲ οἱ παραγενόμενοι πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν παρεκάλουν αὐτὸν σπουδαίως λέγοντες ὅτι ἐστιν Ἄξιός παρέξῃ τοῦτο ᾧ
verses.transliteration: de hoi paragenomenoi pros ton Iēsoun parekaloun auton spoudaiōs legontes hoti estin Axios parexē touto hō
verses.literal: - - They came to - Jesus [and] pleaded with Him earnestly - - [This man] is worthy to have You grant this -

verses.original: γὰρ ἀγαπᾷ ἡμῶν τὸ ἔθνος καὶ αὐτὸς ᾠκοδόμησεν ἡμῖν τὴν συναγωγὴν
verses.transliteration: gar agapa hēmōn to ethnos kai autos ōkodomēsen hēmin tēn synagōgēn
verses.literal: for he loves our - nation and - has built our - synagogue

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐπορεύετο σὺν αὐτοῖς δὲ ἤδη αὐτοῦ οὐ μακρὰν ἀπέχοντος ἀπὸ τῆς οἰκίας ὁ ἑκατοντάρχης ἔπεμψεν φίλους λέγων αὐτῷ Κύριε μὴ σκύλλου γὰρ εἰμι οὐ ἱκανός ἵνα εἰσέλθῃς ὑπὸ μου τὴν στέγην
verses.transliteration: de Ho Iēsous eporeueto syn autois de ēdē autou ou makran apechontos apo tēs oikias ho hekatontarchēs epempsen philous legōn autō Kyrie mē skyllou gar eimi ou hikanos hina eiselthēs hypo mou tēn stegēn
verses.literal: So - Jesus went with them But when He vvv vvv was not far from the house the centurion sent friends with the message . . . Lord {do} not trouble Yourself for I am not worthy to have You come under my - roof

verses.original: διὸ οὐδὲ ἠξίωσα ἐμαυτὸν ἐλθεῖν πρὸς σὲ ἀλλὰ εἰπὲ λόγῳ καὶ μου ὁ παῖς ἰαθήτω
verses.transliteration: dio oude ēxiōsa emauton elthein pros se alla eipe logō kai mou ho pais iathētō
verses.literal: That is why vvv I did not consider myself worthy . . . to come to You But [just] say [the] word and my - servant will be healed

verses.original: γὰρ ἐγὼ καὶ εἰμι ἄνθρωπός τασσόμενος ὑπὸ ἐξουσίαν ἔχων στρατιώτας ὑπ’ ἐμαυτὸν καὶ λέγω τούτῳ Πορεύθητι καὶ πορεύεται καὶ ἄλλῳ Ἔρχου καὶ ἔρχεται καὶ τῷ μου δούλῳ Ποίησον τοῦτο καὶ ποιεῖ
verses.transliteration: gar egō kai eimi anthrōpos tassomenos hypo exousian echōn stratiōtas hyp’ emauton kai legō toutō Poreuthēti kai poreuetai kai allō Erchou kai erchetai kai tō mou doulō Poiēson touto kai poiei
verses.literal: For I [myself] am a man vvv under authority with soldiers under me - I tell [one] to go and he goes and another to come and he comes [I tell] . . . my servant to do [something] and he does [it]

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Ἀκούσας ταῦτα Ἰησοῦς ἐθαύμασεν αὐτόν καὶ στραφεὶς τῷ ὄχλῳ ἀκολουθοῦντι αὐτῷ εἶπεν Λέγω ὑμῖν οὐδὲ ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ εὗρον τοσαύτην πίστιν
verses.transliteration: de ho Akousas tauta Iēsous ethaumasen auton kai strapheis tō ochlō akolouthounti autō eipen Legō hymin oude en tō Israēl heuron tosautēn pistin
verses.literal: [When] vvv [Jesus] heard [this] [He] marveled at [the centurion] - Turning to the crowd following Him He said I tell you not even in - Israel have I found such great faith

verses.original: καὶ οἱ πεμφθέντες ὑποστρέψαντες εἰς τὸν οἶκον εὗρον τὸν δοῦλον ὑγιαίνοντα
verses.transliteration: kai hoi pemphthentes hypostrepsantes eis ton oikon heuron ton doulon hygiainonta
verses.literal: And [when] the messengers returned to the house they found the servant in good health

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἑξῆς ἐπορεύθη εἰς πόλιν καλουμένην Ναΐν καὶ αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ συνεπορεύοντο αὐτῷ καὶ πολύς ὄχλος
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto en tō hexēs eporeuthē eis polin kaloumenēn Nain kai autou hoi mathētai syneporeuonto autō kai polys ochlos
verses.literal: - Soon afterward . . . . . . . . . [Jesus] went to a town called Nain - His - disciples went with Him accompanied by a large crowd

verses.original: δὲ ὡς ἤγγισεν τῇ τῆς πόλεως πύλῃ καὶ ἰδοὺ τεθνηκὼς ἐξεκομίζετο μονογενὴς υἱὸς τῇ αὐτοῦ μητρὶ καὶ αὐτὴ ἦν χήρα καὶ ἱκανὸς ὄχλος τῆς πόλεως ἦν σὺν αὐτῇ
verses.transliteration: de hōs ēngisen tē tēs poleōs pylē kai idou tethnēkōs exekomizeto monogenēs huios tē autou mētri kai autē ēn chēra kai hikanos ochlos tēs poleōs ēn syn autē
verses.literal: - As He approached the - town gate - He saw a dead man being carried out the only son of his mother and she was a widow And a large crowd from the town was with her

verses.original: καὶ ὁ Κύριος ἰδὼν αὐτὴν ἐσπλαγχνίσθη ἐπ’ αὐτῇ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ Μὴ κλαῖε
verses.transliteration: kai ho Kyrios idōn autēn esplanchnisthē ep’ autē kai eipen autē Mē klaie
verses.literal: When the Lord saw her He had compassion on her and said - {Do} not weep

verses.original: Καὶ προσελθὼν ἥψατο τῆς σοροῦ δὲ οἱ βαστάζοντες ἔστησαν Νεανίσκε καὶ εἶπεν λέγω σοὶ ἐγέρθητι
verses.transliteration: Kai proselthōn hēpsato tēs sorou de hoi bastazontes estēsan Neaniske kai eipen legō soi egerthēti
verses.literal: Then He went up [and] touched the coffin and those carrying it stood still Young man - He said I tell you get up

verses.original: καὶ ὁ νεκρὸς ἀνεκάθισεν καὶ ἤρξατο λαλεῖν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὸν τῇ αὐτοῦ μητρὶ
verses.transliteration: kai ho nekros anekathisen kai ērxato lalein kai edōken auton tē autou mētri
verses.literal: And the dead [man] sat up and began to speak Then [Jesus] gave him {back} to his mother

verses.original: δὲ φόβος Ἔλαβεν πάντας καὶ ἐδόξαζον τὸν Θεὸν μέγας Προφήτης ἠγέρθη ἐν ἡμῖν καὶ ὅτι λέγοντες ὅτι ὁ Θεὸς Ἐπεσκέψατο αὐτοῦ τὸν λαὸν
verses.transliteration: de phobos Elaben pantas kai edoxazon ton Theon megas Prophētēs ēgerthē en hēmin kai hoti legontes hoti ho Theos Epeskepsato autou ton laon
verses.literal: - A sense of awe swept over all [of them] and they glorified - God A great prophet has appeared among us - - they said - - God has visited His - people

verses.original: καὶ οὗτος ὁ λόγος περὶ αὐτοῦ ἐξῆλθεν ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ καὶ πάσῃ τῇ περιχώρῳ
verses.transliteration: kai houtos ho logos peri autou exēlthen en holē tē Ioudaia kai pasē tē perichōrō
verses.literal: And [the] - news about [Jesus] spread throughout . . . - Judea and all the surrounding region

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἀπήγγειλαν Ἰωάννῃ περὶ πάντων τούτων
verses.transliteration: Kai autou hoi mathētai apēngeilan Iōannē peri pantōn toutōn
verses.literal: Then [John’s] - disciples informed [him] about all these things

verses.original: καὶ Ἰωάννης προσκαλεσάμενος τινὰς δύο τῶν αὐτοῦ μαθητῶν ὁ ἔπεμψεν πρὸς λέγων τὸν Κύριον εἶ Σὺ ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἢ προσδοκῶμεν ἄλλον
verses.transliteration: kai Iōannēs proskalesamenos tinas dyo tōn autou mathētōn ho epempsen pros legōn ton Kyrion ei Sy ho erchomenos ē prosdokōmen allon
verses.literal: So John called vvv two of his disciples - [and] sent [them] to ask the Lord Are You the One who was to come or should we look for someone else

verses.original: δὲ οἱ ἄνδρες Παραγενόμενοι πρὸς αὐτὸν εἶπαν Ἰωάννης ὁ Βαπτιστὴς ἀπέστειλεν ἡμᾶς πρὸς λέγων σὲ εἶ Σὺ ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἢ προσδοκῶμεν ἄλλον
verses.transliteration: de hoi andres Paragenomenoi pros auton eipan Iōannēs ho Baptistēs apesteilen hēmas pros legōn se ei Sy ho erchomenos ē prosdokōmen allon
verses.literal: [When] the men came to [Jesus] they said John the Baptist sent us to ask - Are You the One who was to come or should we look for someone else

verses.original: Ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐθεράπευσεν πολλοὺς ἀπὸ νόσων καὶ μαστίγων καὶ πονηρῶν πνευμάτων καὶ ἐχαρίσατο βλέπειν πολλοῖς τυφλοῖς
verses.transliteration: En ekeinē tē hōra etherapeusen pollous apo nosōn kai mastigōn kai ponērōn pneumatōn kai echarisato blepein pollois typhlois
verses.literal: At that very - hour [Jesus] healed many [people] of [their] diseases - afflictions and evil spirits and He gave sight to many [who were] blind

verses.original: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Πορευθέντες ἀπαγγείλατε Ἰωάννῃ ἃ εἴδετε καὶ ἠκούσατε τυφλοὶ ἀναβλέπουσιν χωλοὶ περιπατοῦσιν λεπροὶ καθαρίζονται καὶ κωφοὶ ἀκούουσιν νεκροὶ ἐγείρονται εὐαγγελίζονται πτωχοὶ
verses.transliteration: kai apokritheis eipen autois Poreuthentes apangeilate Iōannē ha eidete kai ēkousate typhloi anablepousin chōloi peripatousin leproi katharizontai kai kōphoi akouousin nekroi egeirontai euangelizontai ptōchoi
verses.literal: So He replied . . . . . . Go [back] [and] report to John what you have seen and heard [The] blind receive sight [the] lame walk [the] lepers are cleansed - [the] deaf hear [the] dead are raised [and the] good news is preached [to the] poor

verses.original: καὶ μακάριός ἐστιν ὃς σκανδαλισθῇ ἐὰν μὴ ἐν ἐμοί
verses.transliteration: kai makarios estin hos skandalisthē ean mē en emoi
verses.literal: - Blessed is the [one who] does not fall away . . . . . . on account of Me

verses.original: δὲ τῶν Ἰωάννου ἀγγέλων Ἀπελθόντων ἤρξατο λέγειν πρὸς τοὺς ὄχλους περὶ Ἰωάννου Τί ἐξήλθατε εἰς τὴν ἔρημον θεάσασθαι κάλαμον σαλευόμενον ὑπὸ ἀνέμου
verses.transliteration: de tōn Iōannou angelōn Apelthontōn ērxato legein pros tous ochlous peri Iōannou Ti exēlthate eis tēn erēmon theasasthai kalamon saleuomenon hypo anemou
verses.literal: After - John’s messengers had left [Jesus] began to speak to the crowds about John What did you go out into the wilderness to see A reed swaying in [the] wind

verses.original: ἀλλὰ τί ἐξήλθατε ἰδεῖν ἄνθρωπον ἠμφιεσμένον ἐν μαλακοῖς ἱματίοις ἰδοὺ οἱ ἐν ἐνδόξῳ ἱματισμῷ καὶ ὑπάρχοντες τρυφῇ εἰσίν ἐν τοῖς βασιλείοις
verses.transliteration: alla ti exēlthate idein anthrōpon ēmphiesmenon en malakois himatiois idou hoi en endoxō himatismō kai hyparchontes tryphē eisin en tois basileiois
verses.literal: Otherwise what did you go out to see A man dressed in fine clothes Look those who [wear] elegant clothing and live in luxury are found in - palaces

verses.original: τί Ἀλλὰ ἐξήλθατε ἰδεῖν προφήτην ναί λέγω ὑμῖν καὶ περισσότερον προφήτου
verses.transliteration: ti Alla exēlthate idein prophētēn nai legō hymin kai perissoteron prophētou
verses.literal: What then did you go out to see A prophet Yes I tell you and more than a prophet

verses.original: οὗτός ἐστιν περὶ οὗ γέγραπται Ἰδοὺ ἀποστέλλω μου τὸν ἄγγελόν πρὸ σου προσώπου Ὃς κατασκευάσει σου τὴν ὁδόν ἔμπροσθέν σου
verses.transliteration: houtos estin peri hou gegraptai Idou apostellō mou ton angelon pro sou prosōpou Hos kataskeuasei sou tēn hodon emprosthen sou
verses.literal: This is the one about whom it is written Behold I will send My - messenger ahead of You . . . . . . who will prepare Your - way before You

verses.original: Λέγω ὑμῖν ἐν γεννητοῖς γυναικῶν ἐστιν οὐδείς μείζων Ἰωάννου δὲ ὁ μικρότερος ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστιν μείζων αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Legō hymin en gennētois gynaikōn estin oudeis meizōn Iōannou de ho mikroteros en tē basileia tou Theou estin meizōn autou
verses.literal: I tell you among [those] born of women there is no one greater than John yet even the least in the kingdom of God is greater than he

verses.original: Καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἀκούσας καὶ οἱ τελῶναι ἐδικαίωσαν τὸν Θεόν βαπτισθέντες τὸ βάπτισμα Ἰωάννου
verses.transliteration: Kai pas ho laos akousas kai hoi telōnai edikaiōsan ton Theon baptisthentes to baptisma Iōannou
verses.literal: - All the people [who] heard [this] even the tax collectors acknowledged God’s justice . . . . . . [For] they had received the baptism . . . . . . of John

verses.original: δὲ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι καὶ οἱ νομικοὶ ἠθέτησαν τὴν τοῦ Θεοῦ βουλὴν εἰς ἑαυτούς μὴ βαπτισθέντες ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: de hoi Pharisaioi kai hoi nomikoi ēthetēsan tēn tou Theou boulēn eis heautous mē baptisthentes hyp’ autou
verses.literal: But the Pharisees and - experts in the law rejected - - God’s purpose for themselves [because] {they had} not been baptized by [John]

verses.original: Τίνι οὖν ὁμοιώσω τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ταύτης τῆς γενεᾶς καὶ τίνι εἰσὶν ὅμοιοι
verses.transliteration: Tini oun homoiōsō tous anthrōpous tautēs tēs geneas kai tini eisin homoioi
verses.literal: To what then can I compare the men of this - generation - What are they like

verses.original: εἰσιν ὅμοιοί παιδίοις τοῖς καθημένοις ἐν ἀγορᾷ καὶ προσφωνοῦσιν ἀλλήλοις ἃ λέγει Ηὐλήσαμεν ὑμῖν καὶ οὐκ ὠρχήσασθε Ἐθρηνήσαμεν καὶ οὐκ ἐκλαύσατε
verses.transliteration: eisin homoioi paidiois tois kathēmenois en agora kai prosphōnousin allēlois ha legei Ēulēsamen hymin kai ouk ōrchēsasthe Ethrēnēsamen kai ouk eklausate
verses.literal: They are like children - sitting in [the] marketplace and calling out to one another . . . . . . We played the flute for you and vvv you did not dance we sang a dirge and vvv you did not weep

verses.original: γὰρ Ἰωάννης ὁ Βαπτιστὴς Ἐλήλυθεν μὴ ἐσθίων ἄρτον μήτε πίνων οἶνον καὶ λέγετε ἔχει Δαιμόνιον
verses.transliteration: gar Iōannēs ho Baptistēs Elēlythen mē esthiōn arton mēte pinōn oinon kai legete echei Daimonion
verses.literal: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine and you say He has a demon

verses.original: ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐλήλυθεν ἐσθίων καὶ πίνων καὶ λέγετε Ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπος φάγος καὶ οἰνοπότης φίλος τελωνῶν καὶ ἁμαρτωλῶν
verses.transliteration: ho Huios tou anthrōpou elēlythen esthiōn kai pinōn kai legete Idou anthrōpos phagos kai oinopotēs philos telōnōn kai hamartōlōn
verses.literal: The Son - of Man came eating and drinking and you say Look [at this] glutton and drunkard a friend of tax collectors and sinners

verses.original: καὶ ἡ σοφία ἐδικαιώθη ἀπὸ πάντων αὐτῆς τῶν τέκνων
verses.transliteration: kai hē sophia edikaiōthē apo pantōn autēs tōn teknōn
verses.literal: But - wisdom is vindicated by all her - children

verses.original: δέ τις τῶν Φαρισαίων Ἠρώτα αὐτὸν ἵνα φάγῃ μετ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὸν τοῦ Φαρισαίου οἶκον κατεκλίθη
verses.transliteration: de tis tōn Pharisaiōn Ērōta auton hina phagē met’ autou kai eiselthōn eis ton tou Pharisaiou oikon kateklithē
verses.literal: Then one of the Pharisees invited [Jesus] to eat with him and He entered . . . the - Pharisee’s house [and] reclined at the table

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἥτις ἦν ἁμαρτωλός γυνὴ ἐν τῇ πόλει καὶ ἐπιγνοῦσα ὅτι κατάκειται ἐν τῇ τοῦ Φαρισαίου οἰκίᾳ κομίσασα ἀλάβαστρον μύρου
verses.transliteration: kai idou hētis ēn hamartōlos gynē en tē polei kai epignousa hoti katakeitai en tē tou Pharisaiou oikia komisasa alabastron myrou
verses.literal: When . . . vvv vvv a sinful woman from [that] town - learned that [Jesus] was dining vvv vvv vvv vvv [there] she brought an alabaster jar of perfume

verses.original: καὶ στᾶσα ὀπίσω παρὰ αὐτοῦ τοὺς πόδας κλαίουσα ἤρξατο βρέχειν αὐτοῦ πόδας τοὺς τοῖς δάκρυσιν καὶ ἐξέμασσεν ταῖς θριξὶν τῆς αὐτῆς κεφαλῆς καὶ κατεφίλει αὐτοῦ τοὺς πόδας καὶ ἤλειφεν τῷ μύρῳ
verses.transliteration: kai stasa opisō para autou tous podas klaiousa ērxato brechein autou podas tous tois dakrysin kai exemassen tais thrixin tēs autēs kephalēs kai katephilei autou tous podas kai ēleiphen tō myrō
verses.literal: [As] she stood behind Him at His - feet weeping she began to wet His feet with [her] tears and wipe [them] with her hair . . . . . . . . . Then she kissed His - feet and anointed [them] with the perfume

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Φαρισαῖος ὁ καλέσας αὐτὸν Ἰδὼν εἶπεν ἐν ἑαυτῷ λέγων εἰ Οὗτος ἦν προφήτης ἂν ἐγίνωσκεν τίς καὶ ποταπὴ ἡ γυνὴ ἥτις ἅπτεται αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐστιν ἁμαρτωλός
verses.transliteration: de ho Pharisaios ho kalesas auton Idōn eipen en heautō legōn ei Houtos ēn prophētēs an eginōsken tis kai potapē hē gynē hētis haptetai autou hoti estin hamartōlos
verses.literal: When the Pharisee who had invited [Jesus] saw [this] he said to himself - If this [man] were a prophet - He would know who [this is] and what kind of woman - is touching Him for she is a sinner

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν Σίμων ἔχω τι εἰπεῖν σοί εἰπέ Διδάσκαλε δέ Ὁ φησίν
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous apokritheis eipen pros auton Simōn echō ti eipein soi eipe Didaskale de Ho phēsin
verses.literal: But - Jesus answered . . . . . . him Simon I have something to tell you Tell [me] Teacher - - he said

verses.original: Δύο ἦσαν χρεοφειλέται τινι δανιστῇ ὁ εἷς ὤφειλεν πεντακόσια δηνάρια δὲ ὁ ἕτερος πεντήκοντα
verses.transliteration: Dyo ēsan chreopheiletai tini danistē ho heis ōpheilen pentakosia dēnaria de ho heteros pentēkonta
verses.literal: Two [men] were debtors vvv to a certain moneylender - One owed [him] five hundred denarii and the other fifty

verses.original: αὐτῶν ἐχόντων μὴ ἀποδοῦναι ἐχαρίσατο ἀμφοτέροις τίς αὐτῶν οὖν ἀγαπήσει αὐτόν πλεῖον
verses.transliteration: autōn echontōn mē apodounai echarisato amphoterois tis autōn oun agapēsei auton pleion
verses.literal: [When] they were unable . . . to repay [him] he forgave both [of them] Which [one] then will love him more

verses.original: Ὑπολαμβάνω ὅτι ᾧ ἐχαρίσατο τὸ πλεῖον Σίμων Ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν ἔκρινας Ὀρθῶς δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Hypolambanō hoti hō echarisato to pleion Simōn Apokritheis eipen ekrinas Orthōs de Ho eipen autō
verses.literal: I suppose - the [one who] was forgiven - more Simon replied . . . You have judged correctly - - [Jesus] said -

verses.original: Καὶ στραφεὶς πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα ἔφη τῷ Σίμωνι Βλέπεις ταύτην τὴν γυναῖκα εἰσῆλθόν εἰς σου τὴν οἰκίαν ἔδωκας οὐκ ὕδωρ ἐπὶ μοι πόδας δὲ ἔβρεξέν μου τοὺς πόδας αὕτη τοῖς δάκρυσιν καὶ ἐξέμαξεν ταῖς αὐτῆς θριξὶν
verses.transliteration: Kai strapheis pros tēn gynaika ephē tō Simōni Blepeis tautēn tēn gynaika eisēlthon eis sou tēn oikian edōkas ouk hydōr epi moi podas de ebrexen mou tous podas hautē tois dakrysin kai exemaxen tais autēs thrixin
verses.literal: And turning toward the woman He said - to Simon Do you see this - woman [When] I entered . . . your - house you did not give [Me] . . . water for My feet but she wet My - feet with her - tears and wiped [them] with her hair

verses.original: οὐκ ἔδωκας μοι φίλημά δὲ αὕτη οὐ διέλιπεν καταφιλοῦσά μου τοὺς πόδας ἀφ’ ἧς εἰσῆλθον
verses.transliteration: ouk edōkas moi philēma de hautē ou dielipen kataphilousa mou tous podas aph’ hēs eisēlthon
verses.literal: vvv You did not greet Me with a kiss but she vvv has not stopped kissing My - feet since . . . I arrived

verses.original: οὐκ ἤλειψας μου τὴν κεφαλήν ἐλαίῳ δὲ αὕτη ἤλειψεν μου τοὺς πόδας μύρῳ
verses.transliteration: ouk ēleipsas mou tēn kephalēn elaiō de hautē ēleipsen mou tous podas myrō
verses.literal: vvv You did not anoint My - head with oil but she has anointed My - feet with perfume

verses.original: χάριν λέγω σοι οὗ αὐτῆς αἱ πολλαί αἱ ἁμαρτίαι ἀφέωνται ὅτι ἠγάπησεν πολύ δὲ ᾧ ἀφίεται ὀλίγον ἀγαπᾷ ὀλίγον
verses.transliteration: charin legō soi hou autēs hai pollai hai hamartiai apheōntai hoti ēgapēsen poly de hō aphietai oligon agapa oligon
verses.literal: Therefore I tell you - her - many - sins have been forgiven for she has loved much But he who has been forgiven little loves little

verses.original: δὲ Εἶπεν αὐτῇ σου αἱ ἁμαρτίαι Ἀφέωνταί
verses.transliteration: de Eipen autē sou hai hamartiai Apheōntai
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] said to her Your - sins are forgiven

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ συνανακείμενοι ἤρξαντο λέγειν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς Τίς ἐστιν οὗτός ὃς καὶ ἀφίησιν ἁμαρτίας
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi synanakeimenoi ērxanto legein en heautois Tis estin houtos hos kai aphiēsin hamartias
verses.literal: But those at the table began to say to themselves Who is this who even forgives sins

verses.original: δὲ Εἶπεν πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα σου Ἡ πίστις σέσωκέν σε πορεύου εἰς εἰρήνην
verses.transliteration: de Eipen pros tēn gynaika sou Hē pistis sesōken se poreuou eis eirēnēn
verses.literal: And [Jesus] told . . . the woman Your - faith has saved you go in peace
